;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)|2019 Northwestern Syria offensive]]
**The [[Al-Qaeda]]-linked faction [[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham]] (HTS) acknowledges "a redeployment" south of the strategic town of [[Khan Shaykhun]]. [https://apnews.com/7385d040867247ddbf7bbfae99847e04 (AP News)]
**Media close to the government reports that the [[Syrian Army]] enters the northern sector of the town of Khan Shaykhun, following the reported HTS withdrawal. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-syrian-army-enters-khan-sheikhoun-to-secure-city/ (''Al-Masdar News'')]

;Health and environment
*The [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Spanish Ministry of Health]] declares an outbreak of [[listeriosis]] in [[Andalusia]] as a national health alert after cases are reported in Asturias, Madrid, Catalonia and Extremadura, including one death. [http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20190820/sanidad-decreta-alerta-sanitaria-nacional-brote-listeriosis-detectado-andalucia/1977367.shtml (RTVE)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Nicolás Maduro]] confirms United States reports that top Venezuelan officials are having secret meetings with members of the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]. Maduro claims that the talks encourage Trump to listen to him; United States sources claim that the talks encourage Maduro supporters to defect. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/21/venezuelan-leader-nicolas-maduro-confirms-months-of-secret-us-talks (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Proposed United States purchase of Greenland]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] cancels his September state visit to Denmark because [[Prime Minister of Denmark|Danish Prime Minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] says that she has no interest in discussing the purchase of [[Greenland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-49416740 (BBC News)]
*[[Holy See–Vietnam relations]]
**The two sides meet in the [[Vatican City|Vatican]] and discuss [[Bilateralism|bilateral relations]], ecclesial life and the future visit of Vatican [[Cardinal Secretary of State|Secretary of State]], Cardinal [[Pietro Parolin]]. The Vietnam — Holy See Joint Working Group first met in 2009. [[Vietnam]], a Communist nation of 97 million, is 7% Catholic. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2019-08/holy-see-vietnam-joint-working-group-vatican.html (Vatican News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Brazil]]
**Thirty-seven passengers on a bus over [[Rio–Niterói Bridge]], [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], are held hostage before police fatally shoot the armed hijacker. After closer inspection, police discover that the hijacker used a fake plastic gun. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49406032 (BBC News)] [https://extra.globo.com/casos-de-policia/sequestrador-de-onibus-na-ponte-rio-niteroi-usava-arma-de-brinquedo-afirma-porta-voz-da-policia-militar-23889013.html (''Extra'')]
*Former professional basketball player [[Mateen Cleaves]] is acquitted of several sex crimes in a court in his hometown of [[Flint, Michigan]]. [https://www.mlive.com/news/flint/2019/08/mateen-cleaves-found-not-guilty-in-sex-assault-trial.html (MLive)] [https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Mateen-Cleaves-found-not-guilty-of-sexual-assault-charges-557032331.html (WJRT-TV)]
*A modification of the [[Volcker rule]] is approved by the [[Office of the Comptroller of the Currency|OCC]] and the [[Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation|FDIC]]. The new version eases rules on [[proprietary trading]] by Wall Street banks. Consumer groups criticize the rule change, claiming that it removes protections from taxpayers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-banks-volcker/u-s-regulators-hand-wall-street-a-major-win-with-stripped-down-volcker-rule-idUSKCN1VA1B8 (Reuters)]
*The [[Texas Department of Information Resources]] reports that the computer systems of 23 towns in the state were hit by a [[ransomware]] attack on August 16. "One single threat actor" is suspected. [https://www.insider.com/texas-ransomware-attack-affects-23-towns-single-attacker-2019-8 (Insider)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Italy]], [[Conte I Cabinet|Conte Cabinet]]
**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] resigns. He criticizes [[Deputy Prime Minister of Italy|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Matteo Salvini]], accusing him of sinking the ruling coalition for personal and political gain. The [[President of Italy]], [[Sergio Mattarella]], accepts Conte's resignation and announces that he will start consultations with party leaders. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics/italian-pm-resigns-denounces-salvini-for-sinking-government-idUSKCN1VA0TE (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-president-decision/italys-president-accepts-contes-resignation-calls-for-consultations-idUSKCN1VA22L (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[List of unmanned aerial vehicles]]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] announces that the six-tonne satellite-controlled reconnaissance drone [[Altius-U]] has performed its maiden flight. [https://tass.com/defense/1074237 (TASS)]

;Sports
*[[Expansion of Major League Soccer]]
**[[Major League Soccer]], the top level of the men's [[Association football|sport]] in the U.S., announces that [[St. Louis MLS team|a team]] in [[St. Louis]], [[Missouri]] will become the league's 28th team, most likely in 2022. The ownership group, led by several female members of the Taylor family that controls the [[Enterprise Holdings]] car rental company, is the first in MLS in which women hold a majority interest. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/major-league-soccer/story/3925142/mls-expands-to-st-louis-team-to-start-in-2022 (ESPN)]
